ambient_events: The holosign rotates a degree, as if turning to keep you in view.
Glyphs you shouldn't be able to read resolve into words, then scatter.
A grid of faint blue lines flickers into being underfoot, then thinks better of it.
The air tastes faintly of copper and ozone, the way a thought does just before you have it.
description: A blue lattice of light runs off in every direction, humming. At its center a holosign, a slab of soft light, turns slowly on nothing. You've never seen a holosign before, and you know exactly how to read one.
name: The Lattice
